surfaces.label: Operator API authorization and data exposure
surfaces.notes: All Sprint 6 operator reads and writes require an active administrator; receipt images use authenticated content access and no-store responses.

surfaces.label: Duplicate grouping and cross-device isolation
surfaces.notes: Deterministic grouping remains scoped by device and receipt type; operator views preserve device provenance.

surfaces.label: Excel generation and formula injection
surfaces.notes: Export is macro-free, in-memory, capped at 5000 rows, typed where appropriate, and escapes formula prefixes after leading whitespace.

surfaces.label: Frontend XSS, Help rendering, token handling, and caching
surfaces.notes: React text rendering is used without raw HTML injection; bearer tokens stay in memory; operator responses are no-store; contextual Help uses registered static topics.

surfaces.label: Pagination, search, retry, and export abuse bounds
surfaces.notes: List limits, offsets, date spans, search length, retry eligibility/attempts, and export rows are server-bounded.

surfaces.label: Operator audit integrity and retention
surfaces.notes: Append-only actions identify actors and durable target UUIDs. The scan found and fixed cascading source foreign keys so audit rows outlive shorter source retention.

surfaces.label: Configuration visibility and error leakage
surfaces.notes: The operational device projection excludes credentials and API errors use stable safe messages without OCR or receipt content.

surfaces.label: Android permission regression
surfaces.notes: Sprint 6 changes no Android source; both built APK manifests were inspected and add no permission.

explicitExclusions.reason: No Sprint 6 Android source change; regression build, instrumentation, and final APK permission inspection were performed separately.
